title: Kentucky to create new Office of Music for state’s live sector
summary: Kentucky governor Andy Beshear has announced plans for the state to open an Office of Music, which will introduce new tax rebates for venues and festivals, as well as establishing a state-wide live industry directory for sector professionals. The industry directory aims to facilitate contact between festivals, venues, promoters, and artists, with industry professionals able to register to use. Registrants will then be verified before gaining access to the database. summary: Live Nation France is launching a new open-air series, Off Track, at the Hippodrome ParisLongchamp horse racing track, with the aim of developing an artist- and experience-led outdoor series in the capital. title: Chainsmokers ‘rushed off stage’ at US college after staging malfunction
summary: The Chainsmokers were “rushed off stage” during a student-run concert at Vanderbilt University in Tennessee after problems with the stage, organisers of the event have said. After leaving the stage during the first song of the set, the electronic duo ultimately finished their performance in a different portion of the site in front of 7,000 fans. After being removed from the stage, the band moved their equipment to the centre of the audience space to play in-the-round. title: US events axed as ‘dangerous’ storm batters East Coast
summary: A slate of festivals and events on the US East Coast was cancelled over the weekend as a powerful nor’easter storm battered the region, including Maryland’s Oceans Calling and New York’s Global Citizen Festival and All Things Go. Among the shelved events were Ed Sheeran’s two nights at Massachusetts’ Gillette Stadium and AC/DC’s show at New York’s MetLife Stadium, the band’s second weather-related cancellation on this leg, after a ‘hundred-year storm’ damaged Toronto’s Rogers Centre . summary: Promoter DTD Concerts has said Danish language pop is enjoying a”growing commercial appeal”, following an on-sale for a 2027 show by Danish singer Christopher which is set to make it the biggest headline concert in Danish history by a homegrown artist.
